replies.body:
Hello Cribiterasu12

We thank you for reporting this possible cheater on the server but we have to decline this report because the evidence are images instead of video. We are thankful for taking the initiative and reporting any possible wrong doers on the server and we will look closer at the player in question in the coming days.

Thank you

PieZ
